What this changes, and why. For anything bigger than a fix, link the issue where it was agreed.

- [ ] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `mypy src tests` and `pytest` pass
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased, if a user would notice the change
- [ ] The docs page the change belongs to says what it does now
- [ ] Any new visible text is translated in `locales/fa.json`
